Over the last few weeks of conversations, a few things about the user have come up repeatedly, and I think they are worth keeping. First, on work: the user has decided to stop taking fixed-price projects. They have also started taking the stairs instead of the lift at the coworking space, which is on the fifth floor, as a small daily habit. They asked me to stop suggesting recipes with mushrooms, because they've realised they really don't like the texture.

Fourth, on family: their parents are planning to visit Lisbon in March 2027 for about three weeks, and the user wants to find a short-term rental nearby rather than having them stay in the flat, because the flat is small. Their nephew, the older of their sister's two kids, has started learning English, and the user sometimes helps with homework over video calls on Saturday mornings.

Finally, on money: they set up a separate savings account for taxes and move 30% of every client payment into it as soon as it arrives. They said this has made the quarterly social security payments much less stressful. They also told me they want to review their health insurance in January, because the premium went up by about 18% this year.
